MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Associate Nurse Unit Manager - Periop Obstetrics and Gynaecology WCH





Job no: 945061

Work type: Part time

Located in: Adelaide CBD

Categories: Medical, Nursing-Midwifery




 

Women's and Children's Health Network, Surgical Services, North Adelaide (5006)

Salary - Classification - RN-M2A - Associate Nursing-Midwifery Unit Manager LV2 - $107,487 to $114,917 + 12% Superannuation and Salary Sacrifice Benefits

Part Time 0.84 FTE, Ongoing Permanent

About WCHN
Join the Women's and Children's Health Network (WCHN), South Australia's leading provider of care for women, babies, children and young people. We're shaping the future of healthcare through compassion, innovation and excellence - with our communities at the heart of everything we do.

What WCHN Can Offer You

Access to salary packaging benefits of up to $9,010 each FBT year for living expenses (e.g. mortgage, rent, utilities, groceries), plus an additional $2,650 each FBT year for meal entertainment expenses.

Access to Fitness Passport (workplace health and fitness program that gives you and your family access to a wide choice of gyms and pools across South Australia.)

Free public transport to and from the Women's and Children's Hospital for SA Health metropolitan hospital staff (excludes network community sites).

Support for you and your family via our Employee Assistance Program.

Relocation financial support may be negotiated, subject to eligibility. Click here for details and contact the enquires person for further information.

About the role

Provides perioperative nursing care in Instrument and Circulating Nurse roles, supporting Obstetrics and Gynaecology Surgery services on a seven-day rotating roster. Assists with managing the clinical needs of Obstetrics and Gynaecology surgical lists while ensuring safe, high-quality, person-centred perioperative patient care.

Key duties of the role

Provides clinical leadership and oversees the delivery of safe, person-centred nursing care, ensuring quality patient outcomes and effective patient flow.

Supports the Nurse Unit Manager with operational management, workforce coordination, resource allocation, budgeting, and service planning.

Leads and fosters a positive team culture focused on collaboration, customer service, safety, learning, and continuous improvement.

Supports staff development through clinical teaching, mentoring, supervision, and facilitating professional learning opportunities.

Contributes to quality improvement, research, clinical auditing, change management, and evidence-based practice initiatives.

Skills and Experience

Registered Nurse eligible for registration with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia, holding or eligible to hold a current practising certificate.

Demonstrated experience in perioperative scrub-scout nursing, delivering safe, high-quality care aligned with National Safety and Quality Health Service Standards.

Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, conflict resolution, and teamwork skills, with experience supporting students and less experienced nurses.

Proven ability to prioritise workloads, meet deadlines, and work effectively with minimal supervision in a dynamic healthcare environment.

Sound knowledge of healthcare legislation, professional standards, quality improvement, risk management, work health and safety, and person- and family-centred care principles.

Enquiries can be directed to

Kate Hanly

Position: Nursing Director - Theatres

Phone: 81617260

E-mail: Kate.Hanly@sa.gov.au

Randstad has exclusively partnered with a premier, rapidly growing contract manufacturer specializing in high-quality skincare, sunscreens, and cosmetic products. operating from a modern, purpose-built facility in the Western Suburbs of Melbourne, our client prides themselves on upholding the highest regulatory standards to deliver exceptional products to a diverse portfolio of brands.  
  This brand new facility is now seeking an experienced, structured, and safety-focused   Production Manager   to join their team and take ownership of their day-to-day operations.  
  The Role  
  As the Production Manager, you will take end-to-end operational ownership of the site's manufacturing, warehousing, and logistics teams. Reporting directly to the Managing Director, you will drive a proactive safety culture while optimizing material flow and production efficiency.  
  Your primary mission will be ensuring that daily production targets, inventory accuracy, and customer delivery timelines are consistently met in strict compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and Work Health & Safety (WHS) standards.  
  Key Responsibilities  
 
  Production Scheduling:   Plan, implement, and oversee daily manufacturing schedules, including coordinating team rosters to meet deadlines.  
  Quality & Compliance:   Ensure all processes adhere to strict GMP and SOP guidelines; guarantee that Batch Manufacturing Records are filled out accurately and in real-time.  
  Safety Leadership:   Champion a robust, safety-first culture across both production floors and the warehouse, maintaining high WHS standards.  
  Plant & Equipment Care:   Coordinate equipment calibrations, scheduled maintenance programs, and validations in accordance with the Validation Master Plan.  
  Warehouse & Logistics:   Manage the receipt of raw materials and the dispatch of finished goods, keeping inventory highly accurate utilizing the company's ERP system.  
  Team Upskilling:   Actively train, mentor, and develop production personnel to ensure absolute compliance with company SOPs and quality frameworks.  
 
  What You Bring  
  Our client is looking for a hands-on operations leader who thrives in highly regulated environments. To be successful, you will ideally possess:  
 
  Industry Experience:   A minimum of 3 years in production management within the cosmetic, sunscreen or pharmaceutical manufacturing sectors. Experience within a   TGA-licensed GMP environment   is essential.  
  Education:   A Bachelor's degree in Science, Operations Management, Pharmacy, Engineering, or a related discipline.  
  Technical Aptitude:   Strong working knowledge of mixing, packing, and filling machinery, with the practical ability to troubleshoot mechanical or quality issues.  
  System Literacy:   Confident experience utilizing ERP or MRP systems for inventory control and production tracking.  
  Communication:   Exceptional communication skills to collaborate effectively with all levels of the business, including reporting quality deviations directly to the Head of Quality  
 
  If you are a driven production professional ready for your next career step, click   "Apply Now"   with your updated resume, or contact Alessandra directly -    alessandra.hernandez@randstad.com.au   

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Make a difference everyday

HammondCare provides expert aged care, home care, dementiacareand palliative care for older people, regardless of circumstances, beliefs,backgroundor financial situation. We are led by our not-for-profit, Christian foundations and backed by research and clinical expertise.

When it comes to our people - those we serve and those who serve - we are committed to inclusion across race, culture, ethnicity, gender, sex, sexuality,religionand ability. In our innovative residences, our hospitals, or in client homes, we aim to set the global standard of relationship-based care for older people with complex needs.

We've been caring for people for over 90 years - so, if you love to care, join us, and make a career move that matters.

It'snot just care.It'sHammondCare.

About The Role

At HammondCare, technology plays a critical role in improving quality of life for people with complex health and aged care needs.We'reseekingan experienced and strategic technology leader to join our executive team asGeneral Manager - DigitalProducts&Platforms.

This is a significant leadership role,reporting to the CIO, you will ownHammondCare'sdigitalplatforms &productscapability, leading the teams responsible for building, evolving, and optimising the platforms that underpin care delivery, workforce productivity, business operations, and future innovation.

You'llhelp shape a modern product and platform operating model, bringing together product management, engineering, agile delivery, platform operations, architecture alignment, vendor management, and value realisation into a single, high-performing capability.

This is an opportunity to lead digital transformation at scale while ensuring our core platformsremainreliable, secure, integrated, and ready to support emerging AI and automation opportunities.

This is apermanentroleworking at St Leonards with hybrid opportunities.

Responsibilities

Define and execute the strategy and roadmap forHammondCare'sdigital products, platforms, and enterprise systems, ensuring alignment to organisational priorities and future growth

The RHW Birthing Services include the areas of Birthing Unit, Birth Centre and the Maternal Assessment Unit. The Midwifery Unit Manager 1 (MUM) is a clinical MUM coordinator role and provides clinical leadership and day to day coordination of the Birthing Services at the Royal Hospital for Women (RHW) in collaboration with the MUM 3 who has overall management responsibility for Birthing Services.

The MUM 1, in partnership with the MUM 3 participates in the recruitment and performance development of staff. The Clinical MUM 1 is responsible to the MUM 3 and functions within the policies and procedures of the NSW Ministry of Health, SESLHD, RHW and the Maternity Division.

Ensure the practice of midwifery care is safe and efficient, maintaining standards of care through continual audits and quality improvement initiatives.

Lead and co-ordinate the midwifery and multi-disciplinary care team at the unit level 

Develop consumer engagement and feedback to improve services to women

Discounted Private Health Insurance.

A demonstrated knowledge and-or experience in the management and delivery of health care services

Proven ability in innovative clinical service delivery, harm minimisation and practice development

Recent clinical experience in Maternity Birthing Services
